name: esign
description: Polls DocuSeal for the matter's pending e-signature submissions (every *.esign.json receipt) and fetches completed signed documents plus audit logs into inbox/esign/<submission_id>/.
auth: DOCUSEAL_API_KEY env or macOS Keychain generic password (service: prosaic.docuseal)
output: inbox/esign/<submission_id>/<signed>.pdf + audit log (staging; triage routes onward)
